classroom_section_roster.describe: List the students on a class roster, with whether each is still enrolled.

classroom_create_item.describe: Create a post in one or more classes; the create post tool is the usual way in.

classroom_update_item.describe: Edit a post's title, text, points, due date or category; the set points tool and the set due tool are the usual way in.
say: change the text of the syllabus post

classroom_delete_item.describe: Delete a post from every class it is in, with its files; it asks first.
say: delete the duplicate Tolerance Check post
get rid of that test post

classroom_set_published.describe: Show a post to students or hide it as a draft.

p_published.name: published
p_published.describe: True to show it, false to hide it.

classroom_set_item_pinned.describe: Pin a post to the top of its classes, or unpin it.
say: pin the syllabus post in Block 4
keep the rubric post at the top

p_pinned.name: pinned
p_pinned.describe: True to pin it, false to unpin it.

classroom_set_rubric.describe: Set or clear an assignment's grading rubric; the set rubric tool is the usual way in.
say: set the rubric on Tolerance Check
clear the rubric on the Shop Fix

classroom_set_html_assignment.describe: Store an HTML assignment's document; the replace html assignment tool is the way in, because it checks students' answers first.
say: attach this HTML file to the assignment

classroom_item_revisions.describe: List the earlier versions of a post, its rubric and its document, newest first.
say: what versions of Tolerance Check are there

classroom_restore_revision.describe: Put a post, its rubric or its document back the way an earlier version had it.
say: restore the previous version of Tolerance Check
roll the Shop Fix back to yesterday's version

p_revision_id.name: version
p_revision_id.describe: The version's id, from the list of earlier versions.

classroom_grade_direct.describe: Record a score out of the assignment's total for one student; the grade tool is the usual way in.

classroom_revoke_grade.describe: Take a grade off a student's work entirely, keeping a copy that can be put back.
say: revoke Mateo's grade on the Shop Fix
take Leo's score off Tolerance Check

classroom_restore_grade.describe: Put back a grade that was revoked, exactly as it was.
say: restore Leo's score on Tolerance Check

classroom_feedback_post.describe: Leave a note on a student's work in progress; the send feedback tool is the usual way in.
say: send Leo feedback on the Shop Fix

classroom_feedback_remove.describe: Remove a feedback note, or one message in it; it asks first.
say: take down the comment on Leo's work

p_thread_id.name: note
p_thread_id.describe: The note's id, from the feedback list.

p_message_id.name: message
p_message_id.describe: One message in the note, to remove only that message.

classroom_feedback_list.describe: List the feedback notes on an assignment, a student or a class, with every reply.
say: what feedback have I left on the Shop Fix
which notes are waiting on students

classroom_quick_post_create.describe: Put a short notice at the top of one or more class pages until a time you choose; the create post tool with kind notice is the usual way in.
say: put up a notice in Block 1
post a notice to every 209H class

classroom_quick_post_take_down.describe: Take a notice down before its time; it asks first.
say: take down the shop closed notice

p_post_id.name: notice
p_post_id.describe: The notice's id, from the list of notices.

classroom_quick_posts.describe: List the notices up in a class right now.
say: what notices are up in Block 1
is the safety notice still up

classroom_student_overview.describe: One student's page in one class, with their work, grades, notebook and activity.
say: how is Mateo doing in Block 2
what's missing for Ana in IDEA100

coin_log_transaction.describe: Log one coin record for a student under a category, with a note; the award coins tool and the fine coins tool are the usual way in.
say: log a coin record for Mateo

args.p_note: Undone through the IDEA Website connector.

coin_reverse_transaction.describe: Reverse one coin record with a reversal record beside it, exactly as Undo does on the Coin Desk; it asks first.
say: undo the award from this morning

p_transaction_id.name: record
p_transaction_id.describe: The coin record's id, from the student's recent records.

coin_admin_lookup.describe: A student's coin balance, wage tier, eating pass and most recent coin records.
say: how many coins does Mateo have

coin_settings_get.describe: The coin economy's settings, such as each fine's amount and the payday rules.
say: what's the fine for a phone
how much is a shop safety fine

coin_fine_sections.describe: The classes you can log fines in from the fine screen.
say: which classes can I fine in

coin_staff_scope.describe: Which coin powers you hold and which classes they cover.
say: what coin powers do I have
am I a full coin admin
which classes are in my coin scope

connector_call.exclude: The connector's own transport; every connector write goes through it, so it is never a tool of its own.

connector_audit_failure.exclude: Records a failed connector write on its own statement; the connector calls it, never a person.

connector_admin_state.describe: Whether the connector is on, and every connection with when it was made and last used.

connector_admin_audit.describe: The connector's own log of every change made through Claude, newest first.
say: list the changes you made this week

p_tool.name: tool
p_tool.describe: Only changes made by this tool.

p_day.name: day
p_day.describe: Only changes on this day, in school time.

p_limit.name: limit
p_limit.describe: At most this many rows, up to 200.

connector_admin_set_enabled.describe: Switch the connector off for every connection, or back on from the admin page; it asks first.

p_enabled.name: on
p_enabled.describe: False to switch it off. It can only be switched back on from the site.

connector_admin_disconnect.describe: Disconnect one Claude connection; it asks first.

p_token_id.name: connection
p_token_id.describe: The connection's id, from the list of connections.

connector_admin_disconnect_all.describe: Disconnect every Claude connection at once; it asks first.

find_student.describe: Find a student in one of your classes by first name, last name or "Daniel R", and say which class they are in.
say: is there a Leo in Block 2
which class is Ana Reyes in

name.describe: The name as you said it: first name, last name, both, or a first name and a last initial.

class.describe: Only look in this class, like 209H Block 2. Leave it out to look in every class you teach.

list_classes.describe: List the classes you teach, with the course and block of each.
say: which blocks do I teach this term

list_posts.describe: List what is posted in one of your classes, with each post's kind, due date and whether students can see it.
say: what's due this week in IDEA100
show me the assignments in Block 2
what drafts do I have in Block 4

class.describe: The class, like 209H Block 1 or IDEA100 Block 3.

due.describe: Only posts due in this window: this week, next week, today, or overdue.

kind.describe: Only this kind of post: assignment, material or announcement.

get_post.describe: Show one post in full, with its points, due date, rubric, which classes it is in and whether students can see it.
say: what's on the Shop Fix post
read me the DFM worksheet's rubric

post.describe: The post's title as you said it, or part of it.

class.describe: The class it is in, when the same title is in more than one.

create_post.describe: Post an assignment, material, announcement or a short notice to one or more of your classes.
say: post an announcement to all 209H sections, bring safety glasses tomorrow
create an assignment in Block 2 called Tolerance Check, 20 points, due Friday at 11:59
put up a notice in Block 1 until the end of the day, the shop is closed
add a material called Fillet Reference to IDEA100

classes.describe: Every class to post to, like 209H Block 2, or all 209H for every section of a course.

kind.describe: assignment, material, announcement, or notice for a short message at the top of the class page.

title.describe: The title. An assignment or material needs one; an announcement or notice does not.

body.describe: The text of the post, as plain text.

due.describe: When an assignment is due: Friday, tomorrow 3pm, Oct 24 11:59pm. A day with no time means 11:59 PM.

published.describe: False to save it as a draft students cannot see yet. Posts are visible by default.

until.describe: For a notice: when it comes down, like end of day or Friday 3pm. Leave it out for the end of the school day.

set_points.describe: Change how many points an assignment is worth.
say: set the Shop Fix to 20 points

post.describe: The assignment's title as you said it.

class.describe: The class it is in, when the same title is in more than one.

set_due.describe: Change when an assignment is due, in school time.
say: move the due date to Monday
make Tolerance Check due Friday at 3
push the Shop Fix to next Wednesday
take the due date off the reflection

post.describe: The assignment's title as you said it.

due.describe: The new due time: Monday, Friday 3pm, Oct 24 11:59pm, or none to remove it.

class.describe: The class it is in, when the same title is in more than one.

set_rubric.describe: Set the grading rubric on an assignment, one row per criterion with its points.
say: set the rubric on Tolerance Check, Accuracy 10, Drawing 10, Reflection 5
give the Shop Fix a rubric with Function 15 and Finish 5
replace the rubric on the DFM worksheet

post.describe: The assignment's title as you said it.

criteria.describe: Each criterion with its points, like Accuracy 10. Optional levels give the score bands from the top level down to zero.

name.describe: What is being graded, like Accuracy.

points.describe: The most points this criterion is worth.

levels.describe: Optional score bands, best first, each with a label, points and what earns it.

class.describe: The class it is in, when the same title is in more than one.

set_published.describe: Show a post to students or hide it again as a draft.
say: hide the Shop Fix from students

post.describe: The post's title as you said it.

published.describe: True to show it to students, false to hide it as a draft.

class.describe: The class it is in, when the same title is in more than one.

replace_html_assignment.describe: Replace an HTML assignment's document with a new file; refuses if any block a student has answered would disappear.
say: replace the Shop Fix HTML in Block 1 with the file I'm sending
show me the block diff before you replace it
upload this new version of the DFM worksheet

post.describe: The assignment's title as you said it.

html.describe: The whole new HTML document, exactly as the file holds it.

class.describe: The class it is in, when the same title is in more than one.

read_grades.describe: Show who has turned in an assignment, who has not, and every score, for one class or all of them.
say: who hasn't turned in Shop Fix in Block 2
show me the grades on Tolerance Check
who still needs grading on the DFM worksheet

post.describe: The assignment's title as you said it.

read_answers.describe: Read what a student answered on an assignment, every question or just one.
say: what did Mateo answer on question 3 of the DFM worksheet
read me Leo's answers on the Shop Fix
show Ana's reflection on Tolerance Check

post.describe: The assignment's title as you said it.

student.describe: The student, as you said the name.

question.describe: One question: its number, its name, or words from its prompt. Leave it out for every answer.

grade.describe: Give a student a score on an assignment, with an optional comment, and return it to them unless you say to hold it.
say: grade Mateo's Shop Fix 18 out of 20, comment fix the fillet callout
give Leo a perfect score on the trophy reflection
score Ana's Tolerance Check 15 and hold it

post.describe: The assignment's title as you said it.

student.describe: The student, as you said the name.

score.describe: The score. Say perfect, or leave it out with perfect true, for full points.

comment.describe: A comment the student reads with the grade.

hold.describe: True to save the grade without returning it to the student yet.

send_feedback.describe: Leave a student a note on their work in progress on an assignment, which they see and can answer.
say: send Mateo feedback on his notebook, cite the datasheet next time
tell Leo his Shop Fix sketch needs dimensions
leave Ana a note on question 2 of the DFM worksheet

post.describe: The assignment's title as you said it.

student.describe: The student, as you said the name.

question.describe: Pin the note to one question: its number, its name, or words from its prompt.

award_coins.describe: Give one or more students IDEA Coins under an award category, with the reason you say.
say: give Mateo in Block 2 five coins for helping clean the shop
award the Shop Fix winners, Mateo and Leo, ten each
give everyone in Block 1 two coins for the clean benches
give Leo a Correct Answer award

students.describe: Each student, as you said the name. Leave it out and name a class to award the whole class.

class.describe: A class to award every enrolled student in, or the class to look in for the names.

amount.describe: Coins each, when the award category takes an amount.

reason.describe: The reason, in your words; it is the note on the coin record.

kind.describe: The award category, like Above and Beyond or Correct Answer in Class. Leave it out to be offered the ones that fit.

fine_coins.describe: Fine one or more students IDEA Coins under a fine category, with the reason you say.
say: fine Daniel R three coins, phone out
fine Leo for leaving without permission

students.describe: Each student, as you said the name.

class.describe: The class to look in for the names.

kind.describe: The fine category, like Off-Task or Disruptive. Leave it out to be offered the ones that fit.

reason.describe: The reason, in your words; it is the note on the coin record.

amount.describe: The amount you said, checked against the category's set amount.

coin_balance.describe: Say how many IDEA Coins a student has, with their most recent coin records.
say: how many coins does Mateo have

student.describe: The student, as you said the name.

undo_last.describe: Undo the most recent change made through Claude that can be undone, such as an award, a fine or a new post.

connector_disconnect.describe: Disconnect this Claude connection from the site; it asks first, and connecting again means signing in again.
